message: ignore-scripts in .npmrc is below the [custom] header, so npm reads it as custom.ignore-scripts and does not apply it; the value above the header applies
fix: Remove the line, or move it above the first [section] header of .npmrc if this value is the one you want

message: min-release-age in .npmrc is below the [custom] header, so npm reads it as custom.min-release-age and does not apply it
fix: Move the line above the first [section] header of .npmrc

message: the depcurfew managed block in .npmrc is below the [custom] header, so npm reads its settings as custom.min-release-age and so on and applies none of them
fix: Run depcurfew apply, which moves the managed block above the first [section] header
